component: apps/web/src/app/globals.css (.topbar > .context-switcher; .context-switcher grid-template-columns); apps/web/src/app/operator-workbench.css (.global-search unconditional width rule)
description: Every authenticated ERP page horizontally overflowed the viewport at tablet and mobile widths (confirmed live: 768px viewport rendered at scrollWidth 1141px; 390px rendered at scrollWidth 796px). Root cause was two-part: (1) .topbar > .context-switcher used flex:0 0 auto, so it never shrank regardless of its own grid's minmax(0,...) tracks; (2) operator-workbench.css (loaded after globals.css) defines an unconditional .global-search { width: min(100%, 620px) } with no media guard, silently overriding globals.css's own max-width:1240px rule that shrinks the search bar to an icon-only launcher on narrow viewports.
root_cause: Two independent cascade bugs compounding: a non-shrinking flex item, and a same-specificity unconditional rule loaded later in the stylesheet order defeating an earlier responsive rule.
fix: Changed .context-switcher's flex-shrink to allow shrinking (min-width:0, grid tracks minmax(0,...) instead of hard px floors) and added ellipsis truncation; added an explicit .global-search { width: auto } override inside operator-workbench.css's own existing max-width:1240px block so its unconditional base rule no longer wins.
test_evidence: Live Chromium measurement before/after: 768px scrollWidth 1141->768 (exact match to innerWidth); 390px scrollWidth 796->390 (exact match). Re-verified via full apps/landing e2e suite (305/305 passed) and manual shell-component screenshots at 1440/768/390px, all overflow=false.

description: The Modules mega menu panel (centered under its trigger, up to 880px wide) rendered with its left edge off-screen at 1024-1110px because the trigger sits ~109px left of true viewport-center at every measured width, and the panel's own width (90vw, effectively ~90% of a 1024px viewport) left no safe margin for that offset in either direction.
root_cause: Panel width computed from 90vw stayed close to full viewport width in the "just reachable" 1024-1180px tier, and centering under an off-center trigger has no room to avoid clipping when the panel is nearly as wide as the viewport itself.
